title: The No-Nonsense Guide to Accepting Bitcoin for Ebook Sales
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: You’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe. Stripe and PayPal reject your applications. Gumroad flags your account. You sell ebooks, templates, or fonts but cannot collect payment. This guide solves that. You will deploy a sovereign commerce stack—your own infrastructure. No platforms. No subscriptions. Own the code, own the payments, own the delivery. This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer architecture built for regions where financial isolation is the norm. You’ll use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational store that accepts Bitcoin, USDT, and 300+ cryptocurrencies. No buyer account required. No KYC. Just direct payment to your wallet.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they centralize control. Your Stripe account can be suspended overnight. Your Gumroad store can be flagged without explanation. This stack decentralizes every layer. Hosting is on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—serverless and stateless. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets—you own the database. File delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—instant and automated. Payments are processed by NOWPayments—0.5% fee, no KYC, and direct to your wallet. The infrastructure is modular. If one component fails, you replace it without downtime. This is sovereignty: you own the stack, the stack does not own you.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a crypto wallet, a domain (optional but recommended), and your digital products. Set up a wallet on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees—under $0.10 per payment. If you have a domain, configure it for Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. If not, use the free subdomain provided. Prepare your products—ebooks, templates, fonts—as downloadable files. Name them clearly (e.g., *YourEbookTitle-v1.0.pdf*). Gather your product descriptions, pricing in USD, and cover images. Finally, sign up for NOWPayments and generate your API key. This key will connect your store to the payment processor. No technical expertise required—the stack handles the integration.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy the backend first. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery. The script verifies payment via NOWPayments’ webhook, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends the download link to the buyer. For Cloudflare Workers, use the Wrangler CLI to deploy your code. For Google Apps Script, use the script editor in Google Drive. Integrate NOWPayments by adding your API key to the script. Test the pipeline manually: simulate a payment, check the order log, and verify the download link works. This step ensures your store functions before going live. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes this setup pre-configured, deployed in 48 hours, and end-to-end tested.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Upload your product pages—HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Link each “Buy Now” button to your payment script. Test the live store: place a real order using testnet crypto (e.g., BSC Testnet BNB). Verify the payment confirms, the order logs, and the file delivers. Once confirmed, switch to mainnet. Share your store link with your audience. Monitor transactions via Supabase or Google Sheets. Respond to buyer inquiries promptly—this builds trust. Your first transaction proves the stack works. The buyer pays in crypto, receives the product instantly, and you retain full control.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack live, scale methodically. Add more products by updating your storefront and backend script. Optimize for mobile—most buyers in your region use smartphones. Implement email notifications using Twilio SendGrid or Gmail’s API. Track sales in Google Sheets or Supabase. Upgrade to Cloudflare R2 for faster file delivery as your traffic grows. Monitor transaction fees—switch networks if costs rise. Document your process for future reference. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes full source code and scaling playbooks. Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link before the test download link expires. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields. Publish your store URL and review your first week of orders in the database to confirm the automated pipeline is running correctly.
No platform intermediary means no percentage cut, no payout delay, and no content policy that can delist your products.
